CatalogBizAttrs.description_en:
The business attributes of the catalog, returned as key-value pairs. The following keys may be included:

ALIAS: the alias of the data source
HOST: the endpoint of the data source
PORT: the connection port of the data source
ENV_TYPE: the environment type of the data source
VERSION: the database version of the data source
SYNC_ALIAS: whether automatic synchronization of instance aliases is enabled
CatalogBizAttrs.description_zh:
Catalog 的业务属性，以键值对形式返回。可能包含以下键：

ALIAS：数据源别名。
HOST：数据源连接地址。
PORT：数据源连接端口。
ENV_TYPE：数据源环境类型。
VERSION：数据源的数据库版本。
SYNC_ALIAS：是否开启自动同步实例别名

CatalogType.description_en:
The type of the catalog. Valid values:

JDBC: relational database catalog
DataLake: data lake catalog
Dataset: knowledge base catalog
CatalogType.description_zh:
Catalog 类型。取值：

JDBC：关系型数据库 Catalog。
DataLake：数据湖 Catalog。
Dataset：知识库 Catalog

CatalogUuid.description_en: The unique identifier of the catalog

DataSourceUuid.description_en: The unique identifier of the data source associated with the catalog
DataSourceUuid.description_zh: Catalog 关联数据源的唯一标识

DbType.description_en: The database type of the data source associated with the catalog. The value is the uppercase name of the database type, such as MYSQL
DbType.description_zh: Catalog 关联数据源的数据库类型，取值为大写的数据库类型名称，例如 MYSQL

Properties.description_en: The extended properties of the catalog, returned as key-value pairs
Properties.description_zh: Catalog 的扩展属性，以键值对形式返回

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the data source associated with the catalog
RegionId.description_zh: Catalog 关联数据源所在的地域 ID

State.description_en:
The status of the catalog. Valid values:

0: Normal. This value is set when the data source is created.
-1: Deleted. This value is set when the data source is deleted.

Disabling a data source does not change the status of the catalog
State.description_zh:
Catalog 状态。取值：

0：正常。创建数据源时设置为该值。
-1：已删除。删除数据源时设置为该值。

禁用数据源不会改变 Catalog 状态

StorageLocation.description_en: The storage location. This property is returned only for catalogs of the DataLake type
StorageLocation.description_zh: 存储位置，仅 DataLake 类型的 Catalog 返回

description_en: Queries the details of an Agentic DMS catalog based on the catalog UUID
description_zh: 根据 Catalog UUID 查询 Agentic DMS 的 Catalog 详情
name: GetAgenticCatalog

parameters.help_en: The catalog UUID. You can obtain it by calling ListAgenticCatalog or SearchAgenticCatalog
parameters.help_zh: Catalog UUID。可通过 ListAgenticCatalog 或 SearchAgenticCatalog 获取
parameters.name: catalog_uuid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when an exception occurs
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码，请求异常时返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：

true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
